decision: The package version is bumped to 1.0.0 for the first major Grounded release, including generated-document graph ownership, full-file generated README and docs, PyPI publication preparation, Apache-2.0 licensing, PEP 561 typed package metadata, and trusted-publishing workflow support.
name: Release PyPI-ready Grounded as 1.0.0
description: Documents the 1.0.0 major version bump so the PyPI-ready release has a canonical Grounded owner.
